issues.description: The UML and problem text define the Ride attribute as 'abbreviation' (char), but the solution implementation names the corresponding field and getter 'shortName' / getShortName(). This identifier mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the expected attribute/getter names and likely causes test failures if the grader expects getAbbreviation()/abbreviation field naming.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier names consistent with the UML/specification: rename the field and getter in the solution (and template) from 'shortName' / getShortName() to 'abbreviation' / getAbbreviation(), or alternatively update the UML/problem statement (and tests) to accept 'shortName' / getShortName() so all artifacts use the same identifier.
